currentCard.explanation: Императорский пингвин — крупнейший из 18 ныне живущих видов. Его колонии разбросаны по побережью Антарктиды; большинство расположено на неподвижном припае между островами или айсбергами.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AAP explicitly identifies emperor as the largest of18 penguin species. Historical larger extinct penguins are excluded by «современный». King second and Gentoo third support distinct credible alternatives; Adélie is a separate smaller Antarctic species, with no second largest key.

absoluteLevel.ground: The emperor as the largest living penguin is a familiar introductory natural-history superlative about an iconic Antarctic species. MAIN requires that single broad fact, not recalling full species taxonomy, second/third ranks, exact mass or colony details. All alternatives remain credible same-group species; their regal labels alone are not treated as proof of the answer. This is an editorial audience judgment, not a survey result.

taxonomyAndAntiOverlap.ground: Basic natural history of an iconic Antarctic animal within polar fauna, with Antarctic/subantarctic alternatives. This tests a size-superlative relation, distinct from group identification, hemispheric distribution, winter breeding, anatomy or classification; no identical Animals MAIN found.
